# MailBlinker
> Free, unbranded, self-hosted email tracker and Mailtrack alternative with real-time Telegram open alerts and rich telemetry.

## Overview
MailBlinker is an open-source, self-hosted email tracking tool written in Python. It pairs a lightweight FastAPI tracking service with a Telegram bot for instant open notifications, anti-cache defense, and heuristic bot detection without watermarks, signatures, or subscription fees.

## Key Features
- Real-time Telegram push notifications upon email open
- 100% unbranded with zero 'Sent with Mailtrack' signatures or footers
- Dual-vector tracking: 1x1 invisible GIF pixel + inline CSS fallback
- Anti-cache defense: Strict Cache-Control headers and dynamic ETag to bypass Gmail proxy caching
- Heuristic bot detection: Integrates CrawlerDetect and user-agents to filter automated corporate security sandboxes (Mimecast, Proofpoint)
- Rich telemetry: IP geolocation (City, Country), ISP/Network detection, device breakdown, OS version, and language detection via BCP 47
- Multi-device divergence detection for email forwarding clues
- Clean Architecture monorepo with FastAPI, async SQLAlchemy, Alembic migrations, and aiogram 3
